kv12.3:1.3: sukhavedaniyo dukkhavedaniyo adukkhamasukhavedaniyo sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto phassena sampayutto vedanāya sampayutto saññāya sampayutto cetanāya sampayutto cittena sampayutto sārammaṇo
kv12.3:1.4: atthi tassa āvajjanā ābhogo samannāhāro manasikāro cetanā patthanā paṇidhīti.
kv12.3:1.6: nanu na sukhavedaniyo na dukkhavedaniyo …pe… anārammaṇo natthi tassa āvajjanā …pe… paṇidhīti.
kv12.3:1.8: hañci na sukhavedaniyo …pe… anārammaṇo natthi tassa āvajjanā …pe… paṇidhi no vata re vattabbe
kv12.3:2.1: phasso vipāko phasso sukhavedaniyo …pe… sārammaṇo atthi tassa āvajjanā …pe… paṇidhīti.
kv12.3:2.3: saddo vipāko saddo sukhavedaniyo …pe… sārammaṇo atthi tassa āvajjanā …pe… paṇidhīti.
kv12.3:3.1: saddo vipāko saddo na sukhavedaniyo …pe… anārammaṇo natthi tassa āvajjanā …pe… paṇidhīti.
kv12.3:3.3: phasso vipāko phasso na sukhavedaniyo na dukkhavedaniyo …pe… anārammaṇo natthi tassa āvajjanā …pe… paṇidhīti.
kv12.3:4.5: so tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā ussannattā vipulattā brahmasaro hoti karavikabhāṇīti
